faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: A few things teams often ask before getting started with Anan.

solutions.question: What does Anan Sustainability build?
solutions.answer: We build practical digital products and SaaS solutions that help organizations manage sustainability work, make sense of their data, and improve day-to-day business processes.

fit.question: Who are your solutions designed for?
fit.answer: We work with businesses and teams looking to make sustainability more manageable through useful digital tools. We start by learning about your organization, goals, and existing workflows.

gettingStarted.question: How do we get started?
gettingStarted.answer: It starts with a conversation. We learn about the challenge you want to solve, discuss the people and systems involved, and agree on clear next steps before any work begins.

customization.question: Can a solution be tailored to our needs?
customization.answer: We shape the approach around your goals and requirements. After learning about your needs, we’ll explain which parts can be configured or tailored and agree on the right scope together.

data.question: How do you handle our data and security requirements?
data.answer: We discuss your data, privacy, and security requirements during discovery, then clarify how they apply to the proposed solution. Specific controls and responsibilities are agreed before implementation.

timing.question: How long does a project take, and what does it cost?
timing.answer: Timing and cost depend on the scope, integrations, and requirements. We clarify the work, milestones, and commercial details with you before moving forward.
